audience: a parent or patient-group leader without medical training

sentences.text: Two conditions, Farber lipogranulomatosis and spinal muscular atrophy with progressive myoclonic epilepsy, are both linked to the gene ASAH1 in curated databases [e_46330a802f74] [e_71f9e31c0e45].
Constellate computed that they share this causal gene, with confidence 0.95, the lowest of the two gene links [e_5c34bdd1fa29].
For the spinal muscular atrophy syndrome, abnormal lower motor neuron shape is a curated, very frequent feature [e_bda06d667c7d].
Progressive muscle wasting far from the center of the body is also listed, but with a lower confidence of 0.5 [e_f73892e916aa].
Two other features, flexion contracture and enlarged liver and spleen, are marked as contradicted for this syndrome, with 2 contradicting records each [e_b3e7c04ccbe4] [e_f32b58f2bf55].
The Farber studies in this set are one trial not yet recruiting and one withdrawn trial, so no active study is shown [e_8d1d18923787] [e_11bb9cf4fb09].
These edges do not show how the two conditions relate in symptoms or what the research funding has found [e_32257d4e4e2e].
